verdicts.reason: A shrinks the yellow date card to an illegible speck (the date is lost), crops the pattern strip into an odd vertical panel, scatters the CTA, logo and kicker with no shared alignment, and shrinks the controller to a tiny icon next to the body copy. B keeps the date card readable, along with the headline, controller and a prominent CTA, but it has flaws: the left column (kicker, logo and date) is loose and not aligned to the rest, the pattern strip is a cramped sliver jammed under the CTA, and the body copy is tiny.
